name: screenocr
title: ScreenOCR
description: Extract text from screen captures and clipboard images locally via OCR
author: huzef44

preferences.name: primaryLanguage
preferences.title: Primary Language (macOS)
preferences.description: Primary Apple Vision language. On Windows, use Select Recognition Languages to choose an installed OCR language.

preferences.name: ocrMode
preferences.title: Recognition Level (macOS)
preferences.description: Apple Vision performance and accuracy. Windows uses its installed OCR engine.

preferences.name: languageCorrection
preferences.title: Options
preferences.description: macOS only: use Apple Vision language correction for more accurate recognition.
preferences.label: Use language correction

preferences.name: playSound
preferences.description: macOS only: play the camera shutter sound when capturing a screen region.
preferences.label: Play sounds

preferences.name: showToast
preferences.description: Show toast notifications for command results
preferences.label: Show toast messages

preferences.name: ignoreLineBreaks
preferences.description: Join recognized lines with spaces instead of line breaks.
preferences.label: Ignore line breaks

preferences.name: keepImage
preferences.description: macOS only: copy the captured image to the clipboard before recognition. Copying recognized text may replace it.
preferences.label: Keep image in clipboard

preferences.name: customWordsList
preferences.title: Custom Words List (macOS)
preferences.description: Comma-separated words that help Apple Vision recognize specialized text. Not used by Windows OCR.
preferences.label: Custom Words List

preferences.name: resultAction
preferences.title: After Recognition
preferences.description: What to do with recognized text. Cross-extension callbacks receive the result directly.

commands.title: Select Recognition Languages
commands.description: Choose recognition languages on macOS or an installed OCR language on Windows
commands.name: preferences
recognize-text
commands.title: Recognize Text
commands.description: Detect all text from the captured screen area

commands.name: recognize-text-fullscreen
commands.title: Recognize Text on Entire Screen
commands.description: Recognize text on the current display on macOS or across all monitors on Windows

commands.name: recognize-clipboard
commands.title: Recognize Text in Clipboard Image
commands.description: Extract text from an image or supported image file in the clipboard

commands.name: detect-barcode
commands.title: Detect Barcode/QR Code
commands.description: Detect barcodes and QR codes from the captured screen area (macOS only)
